g.text: SAO++ power select: the switch common (VLOAD) feeds the timer, the counter and the LEDs. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.

g.desc: SAO++ power select: the switch common (VLOAD) feeds the timer, the counter and the LEDs. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.

g.text: Nothing is wired to SDA, SCL, GPIO1 or GPIO2 (as in the maker's schematic), so no series diode is needed on the cell (docs/standard.md section 3).

g.desc: Nothing is wired to SDA, SCL, GPIO1 or GPIO2 (as in the maker's schematic), so no series diode is needed on the cell (docs/standard.md section 3).

g.text: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.desc: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.text: The maker's circuit: a 555 astable (U1) clocks a 4017 decade counter (U2). Exactly one of Q0..Q9 is high at any time, so one LED is lit and the light steps D1, D2 ... D10, D1 ...

g.desc: The maker's circuit: a 555 astable (U1) clocks a 4017 decade counter (U2). Exactly one of Q0..Q9 is high at any time, so one LED is lit and the light steps D1, D2 ... D10, D1 ...

g.text: U1: R1 (with R4, R5) = RA from VLOAD to DIS, R2 = RB from DIS to THR/TRIG, C2 = timing capacitor, C1 on the control pin, RESET tied high. U2: clock enable (/CP1) and reset (MR) tied low, carry output unused.

g.desc: U1: R1 (with R4, R5) = RA from VLOAD to DIS, R2 = RB from DIS to THR/TRIG, C2 = timing capacitor, C1 on the control pin, RESET tied high. U2: clock enable (/CP1) and reset (MR) tied low, carry output unused.

g.text: Maker's values: 220k, 220 ohm, 0.47 uF = 13.9 steps a second. Here: three 3.3M in parallel (1.1M), 330 ohm, 100 nF = 13.1 steps a second, using only parts SAO++ already stocks. Fit one or two of R1/R4/R5 for 4.4 or 8.7 steps a second.

g.desc: Maker's values: 220k, 220 ohm, 0.47 uF = 13.9 steps a second. Here: three 3.3M in parallel (1.1M), 330 ohm, 100 nF = 13.1 steps a second, using only parts SAO++ already stocks. Fit one or two of R1/R4/R5 for 4.4 or 8.7 steps a second.

g.text: R3 is the maker's one shared LED resistor (470 ohm in his drawing; the house 1.3k here: about 1 mA). His drawing has every LED the wrong way round (cathode to the counter); the LEDs here conduct from counter output to R3.

g.desc: R3 is the maker's one shared LED resistor (470 ohm in his drawing; the house 1.3k here: about 1 mA). His drawing has every LED the wrong way round (cathode to the counter); the LEDs here conduct from counter output to R3.

g.text: U1 is an LMC555 (the NE555 in the maker's drawing needs 4.5 V). U2 must be a 74HC4017 (2 V to 6 V), not a CD4017 (3 V minimum). C3 = supply capacitor (not in the maker's drawing).

g.desc: U1 is an LMC555 (the NE555 in the maker's drawing needs 4.5 V). U2 must be a 74HC4017 (2 V to 6 V), not a CD4017 (3 V minimum). C3 = supply capacitor (not in the maker's drawing).
